title: BizXtreme: The Living Frontier
principle: Expand the original game without replacing its core gameplay loop.

chapters.title: Awakening
chapters.summary: The player discovers a dormant frontier network and begins rebuilding their base, equipment and reputation.

chapters.title: The Broken Signal
chapters.summary: Strange signals appear across the map. Players investigate ruins, trade resources and unlock new traversal routes.

chapters.title: Frontier Alliance
chapters.summary: Factions compete for control of strategic locations. The player chooses alliances and shapes future events.

chapters.title: The Black Aurora
chapters.summary: A rare sky event changes the world and reveals hidden locations, limited-time challenges and unique cosmetics.

chapters.title: The Great Expedition
chapters.summary: A seasonal cooperative campaign brings players together for a world-scale objective while preserving normal gameplay for solo players.
